# Off-experiment parity for every arena call: Open, New, Make and Append must
# behave exactly as Region{}, new, make and append when GOEXPERIMENT is unset.
env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cd m
env GOEXPERIMENT=
logos build -gcflags=-m -o $WORK/offall$GOEXE .
! stderr 'placed in region'
! stderr 'region_escape'
! stderr 'region fallback'
logos run .
stdout '^new 43$'
stdout '^make 4 9$'
stdout '^append 1 2 3$'
go run .
stdout '^new 43$'
stdout '^make 4 9$'
stdout '^append 1 2 3$'

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/arenagoffall

go 1.27

-- m/logos.toml --
[build]
arena = false

-- m/main.go --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"logos/arena"
)

func main() {
	r := arena.Open()
	p := arena.New[int](r)
	*p = 42
	fmt.Println("new", *p+1)
	nodes := arena.Make[int](r, 4)
	nodes[2] = 9
	fmt.Println("make", len(nodes), nodes[2])
	s := arena.Append[int](r, []int{1, 2}, 3)
	fmt.Println("append", s[0], s[1], s[2])
	_ = r
}
